what_this_is: The final throughput experiment ATLAS-THROUGHPUT-00N will run: three genuinely new markets acquired, validated, promoted, deployed and live-verified in one 8-hour operating day. Defined here so the measurement cannot be shaped after the fact. No market named here may have been pre-completed; a market whose shadow package already exists on any branch at the time the experiment starts is disqualified as a NEW acquisition for that day.

size_classification.basis: identity census size at census reconciliation (identity_census_proposed/<market>.json count), the same figure the speed benchmarks report

SMALL_MEDIUM.precedent: Toledo 54 (135 min to promotion-ready), Fort Wayne 58

MEDIUM.precedent: Chattanooga 102 (~300 active minutes), Dayton 129, Lexington 61 is below this band

LARGE.precedent: Nashville 181 (125 active minutes to promotion-ready), Cincinnati 257, Indianapolis 264

markets.rule: three markets, one per band, chosen at experiment start from a list of candidate metros with NO existing branch, proposed census, shadow package, or committed report; the choice is recorded in the experiment's opening artifact with the git ref of every branch at that moment
markets.independence_proof: for each market: git log --all -- 'atlas-dashboard/**/<market_us>_*' and '<market-id>*' returns nothing before the opening artifact's timestamp; scripts/pettripfinder/discovery/config/<market_us>.json does not exist

minimum_thresholds_to_count_as_a_qualifi.census_reconciliation: identity census reconciled against at least two independent lead lanes (OSM extract + one official/brand lane) with every soft row classified and every OUTSIDE_MARKET row carrying its ZIP or state reason

verified_pet_friendly_min.basis: each below the precedent market of its band (Toledo 17, Chattanooga 48, Nashville 80) so the bar is reachable in a day without buying evidence

minimum_thresholds_to_count_as_a_qualifi.allowed_unresolved: unlimited in count, but every unresolved row must carry a ladder next-lane and a reason; no unresolved row may be silently dropped from the census; promotion proceeds with unresolved rows exactly as Toledo 002 and Nashville 001 did
minimum_thresholds_to_count_as_a_qualifi.founder_queue_disclosure: the founder packet must list every hold, every identity/geography/category ruling requested, and every unresolved count BEFORE promotion; a packet item ruled after launch is a defect of the experiment, not a fast launch
minimum_thresholds_to_count_as_a_qualifi.policy_lanes_allowed: owned evidence, brand city pages, brand sitemaps, CVB partner sitemaps, free static capture, attended same-origin fetch, Firecrawl within a per-market credit cap recorded in the paid-readiness report; Bright Data and Google Places only with a written cap and the cross-run ledger consulted
minimum_thresholds_to_count_as_a_qualifi.clean_record_rule: every published record validates under policy_schema.validate_record inside the applier (Toledo 002 precedent) and carries a first-party evidence entry

measurement_method.instrument: scripts/pettripfinder/throughput_profile.py on every pytest invocation (-p scripts.pettripfinder.throughput_profile --ptf-profile-out); the process sampler for RAM/CPU over the whole day; the market speed-benchmark report for lane-by-lane acquisition time; deployment records for deploy and live-verification timestamps
measurement_method.clock: wall-clock ISO timestamps recorded at the START and END of every interval by the tool that performs it, never typed afterwards; a missing timestamp is UNKNOWN, not zero

intervals.ACQUISITION_TIME: first lead-lane request -> shadow market PROMOTION_READY = YES
intervals.VALIDATION_TIME: sum of every pytest session's session_finish.seconds attributable to the market (targeted lanes, delta runs, broad runs), from the plugin
intervals.QUEUE_TIME: PROMOTION_READY -> release-lane admission (the promotion order's first timestamp)
intervals.FOUNDER_WAIT: founder packet written -> first founder ruling timestamp
intervals.FOUNDER_ACTIVE_TIME: sum of founder ruling sessions (packet open -> rulings signed), self-reported per session in the rulings artifact
intervals.PROMOTION_TIME: release-lane admission -> source promoted commit (registry, package, contract, pins)
intervals.ASSEMBLY_TIME: every assembly row's elapsed_seconds in the plugin for the promotion + deployment orders
intervals.DEPLOY_TIME: netlify deploy start -> deploy id returned (deployment record command timestamps)
intervals.RAM: peak_process_tree_working_set_mb from the sampler over the day, and per pytest session peak_working_set_mb
intervals.CPU: cpu_seconds from every session_finish row plus the sampler's cpu_s series
intervals.PROVIDER_COST: Firecrawl credit delta, Bright Data USD, Places requests, from the paid-readiness and ledger reports; the account balance is read live before and after, never estimated
intervals.AI_CI_COST: tokens/minutes per order where the tool reports them; otherwise UNKNOWN

measurement_method.concurrency_proof: while one market holds the release lane, the other two must show acquisition lane completions (report timestamps) at no worse than 1.5x their measured solo duration; the sampler must show system free memory never below 512 MB
measurement_method.success: all three markets FOUNDER_AUTHORIZED_FOR_LAUNCH and live-verified (every route 200, 0 routes removed vs the previous deploy) within 8 hours of the opening artifact, with 0 TRUE_NEW_FAILURE in the critical lane and 0 unintended removals
measurement_method.failure_is_a_result: an unmet threshold is recorded with its interval; the experiment is never re-run on the same markets

not_to_be_done_in_001: this file defines; ATLAS-THROUGHPUT-002 builds the ownership manifest and market-local zone the experiment needs; the experiment itself is a later order
